name: HyperFrames CLI
description: HyperFrames is an open-source, code-first video editor that turns HTML, CSS and GSAP timelines with media assets into deterministic MP4 videos. Its CLI scaffolds projects, launches a local Studio preview, checks compositions and renders video with Chromium and FFmpeg.

notes.text: This is a CLI-only container; connect over SSH, work in /opt/hyperframes_data and create a project with `hyperframes init <name>`.
The Studio preview binds to 127.0.0.1:3002. Use an SSH tunnel to view it in a browser; no LAN-facing web service or login is created.
On ARM64, the installer uses Debian Chromium because upstream does not publish Chrome Headless Shell for Linux ARM64; capture may use the slower screenshot fallback.
